entities.name: PMID:25099342
observations: Comparative phylogeny and synteny analysis concluded the Dact family arose from a chordate-specific ancestor; identified Dact genes were absent outside chordates in the survey.
Authors inferred Wnt regulation was ancestral to Dact, while TGF-β inhibition may have emerged later in the Dact2/4 ancestor; pathway integration is therefore evolutionarily layered.

entities.name: PMID:23417991
observations: Chicken limb expression study found Dact1 co-localized with nuclear β-catenin in developing joint regions and Dact2 was expressed at the interzone near bmpR-1b; authors proposed Dact proteins may modulate/integrate Wnt and TGF-β signaling during limb development.

entities.name: PMID:33186756
observations: Reports Dact/Dapper/Frodo proteins in mammals, birds, amphibians, and fishes; identifies rapidly evolving Dact-4 in Xenopus, with weak homologs in reptiles and fishes but not mammals.
